answer: What keeps this pool honest is Lye leacher wax cake warrant recorded at the lye shed: each wax cake is a year of chandlery logs in the tallow ledger, so a farm must leach, checked by someone the applicant never meets. Each alias adds 110 POA of risk, so 479 aliases carry 52690 POA of risk against a single epoch's reward. Open the wharf and you find a clerk, open the whisper and you find a bill, open the orchard and you find a date. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
